title: "my_penguins"
author: "Saif Syed | ss239839"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins) #import libraries and data 

penguins |> group_by(species) |> summarize(bill_len = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)) # summary table 
penguins
# data plot
ggplot(penguins, mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, col = sex)) + geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) + labs(title = "Body mass vs bill length of penguins, by gender.", x = "Bill Length (mm)", y = "Body Mass (g)", col = "Sex")
```
